title: Nebius Group’s AI Deals With Microsoft And Meta Shift Growth Profile
title_zh: Nebius Group 的人工智能业务与微软和 Meta Shift 增长概况
summary: Nebius Group (NasdaqGS:NBIS) has signed multi billion dollar, multi year partnerships with Microsoft and Meta to support its AI data center operations. The company reports a sharp increase in annual recurring revenue alongside its first period of positive EBITDA.
summary_zh: Nebius Group（纳斯达克GS：NBIS）已与微软和 Meta 签署了价值数十亿美元的多年合作伙伴关系，以支持其人工智能数据中心运营。该公司报告称，在首次实现正 EBITDA 的同时，年度经常性收入也大幅增长。

title: Salesforce Leans Into AI With Cimulate Deal And New Job Cuts
title_zh: Salesforce 通过模拟交易和新裁员转向人工智能
summary: Salesforce has agreed to acquire AI startup Cimulate, which focuses on intent aware search, to strengthen its Agentforce Commerce platform. The company has also announced plans to cut nearly 1,000 jobs as part of a broader AI driven transformation of its operations.
summary_zh: Salesforce 已同意收购专注于意图感知搜索的人工智能初创公司 Cimulate，以加强其 Agentforce Commerce 平台。该公司还宣布计划裁员近 1,000 人，作为更广泛的人工智能驱动的运营转型的一部分。

title: Marketplaces Are the Next Frontier in Publisher Deals With AI Companies
title_zh: 市场是出版商与人工智能公司交易的下一个前沿
summary: Microsoft, Amazon and others are planting flags in a new cottage industry as publishers look for additional revenue.
summary_zh: 随着出版商寻求额外收入，微软、亚马逊和其他公司正在新的家庭手工业中插旗。

title: Salesforce Inc (CRM) Strengthens Outlook with AI and Big Deals
title_zh: Salesforce Inc (CRM) 通过人工智能和大交易增强前景
summary: Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM) is one of the best NYSE stocks to buy for the long term. On February 9, Morgan Stanley analysts named Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM) as one of their nine buy-opportunities following the recent selloff that has roiled software stocks.
summary_zh: Salesforce Inc（纽约证券交易所代码：CRM）是最适合长期购买​​的纽约证券交易所股票之一。 2 月 9 日，摩根士丹利分析师将 Salesforce Inc（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）列为近期软件股遭遇抛售后的九个买入机会之一。

title: Blackstone Repositions Portfolio With Urbaser Deal And Larger Anthropic Stake
title_zh: Blackstone 通过 Urbaser 交易和更大的 Anthropic 股份重新定位投资组合
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX), alongside EQT, has agreed to acquire Spain based waste management company Urbaser, expanding its exposure to infrastructure and environmental services.
summary_zh: Blackstone（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）与 EQT 已同意收购西班牙废物管理公司 Urbaser，扩大其在基础设施和环境服务领域的业务。
